capabilities.risk: A SIL workflow could construct or access physical hardware.
limitations: In-process isolation does not prove firmware or physical-device behavior.

capabilities.risk: A Pi SIL run could escape its private-device sandbox or omit traced proof.
limitations: Pi isolation evidence does not validate attached MCU or printer hardware.

capabilities.risk: Tests could bypass the composed Model, Controller, and MainWindow.
limitations: Offscreen Qt composition does not validate a native compositor.

capabilities.risk: A prepared print array could fail to reach terminal completion.
limitations: Completion is simulated and does not prove physical dispensing.

capabilities.risk: Array lookahead could drain unexpectedly before terminal completion.
limitations: The in-process simulator does not reproduce serial or firmware queue timing.

capabilities.risk: Completion progress could be acknowledged without the required durable intent sequence.
limitations: Host filesystem durability evidence does not characterize power-loss hardware.

capabilities.risk: Terminal execution files could disagree after the last completion.
limitations: Terminal validation covers isolated scenario data only.

capabilities.risk: A user may be unable to create and finalize an experiment through the editor.
limitations: Coverage is limited to the tracked minimal two-well design and does not include prepared rename/refinalize.

capabilities.risk: A finalized but unstarted experiment may not reopen consistently.
limitations: Coverage proves authoritative prepared reload in one isolated application composition, not process restart or resume after printing.

capabilities.risk: A prepared experiment edit or rename may fail or leave conflicting authoritative files.
limitations: Coverage proves material design edits plus rename/refinalization before start and the active zero-progress lock boundary; later lifecycle transitions remain separate scenarios.

capabilities.risk: Material edits to an untouched prepared design may conflict with its existing authoritative execution plan.
limitations: Coverage exercises replicate, well-selection, volume, reagent-target, reagent-mode, fill-mode, and name changes before any execution progress.

capabilities.risk: Experiment design and execution-plan identities may diverge after finalization.
limitations: Coverage checks the tracked minimal design and its v1 prepared execution plan only.

capabilities.risk: An experiment with calibration or print history may remain editable in place.
limitations: Coverage crosses the earliest durable ACTIVE boundary without executing a print command; later progress-bearing locks remain separate lifecycle coverage.

capabilities.risk: A locked experiment may not produce a safe editable copy.
limitations: Coverage proves one minimal A1/A2 copy with a tolerance-only edit; broader design variants remain outside this scenario.

capabilities.risk: A user soft stop may lose progress or resume with duplicates.
limitations: The composed scenario uses the in-process simulator and does not prove firmware or physical motion behavior.

capabilities.risk: A refill-required pause could lose progress or resume incorrectly.
limitations: Volume tracking is disabled, so the production prerequisite is absent.

capabilities.risk: Durable partial progress may not reload and resume authoritatively.
limitations: The fresh application boundary is a separately constructed MVC/simulator graph within one process-wide QApplication, not an operating-system process restart or physical hardware resume.

capabilities.risk: Execution may continue advancing after simulated disconnection.
limitations: Protocol and physical disconnect behavior are outside in-process SIL.

capabilities.risk: Stock passes may use the wrong virtual head or exchange while work is queued.
limitations: Coverage uses normal Qt rack controls and the in-process simulator; it does not validate physical head handling, pressure response, or droplet output.

capabilities.risk: A stream stock may print with mismatched calibration or without its required current manual-refuel check.
limitations: Coverage drives the application-facing simulator and records synthetic operator judgment; it does not validate physical stream flow, refueling, pressure response, or droplet output.

capabilities.risk: Randomized well assignments, calibration identity, exact stock counts, or durable completion may drift across a clean application-session reload.
limitations: The scenario proves application-side simulated identities, persistence, and DISPENSE semantics; it does not prove firmware, protocol, or physical printing behavior.

capabilities.risk: Optimizer-selected stocks, 360 randomized reactions, five calibration identities, exact counts, or durable completion could drift across clean application sessions.
limitations: The scenario proves application-side optimizer, calibration, persistence, and DISPENSE semantics; it does not prove firmware, protocol, or physical printing behavior.

capabilities.risk: A blocked Qt event loop may go undetected or lack diagnostic attribution.
limitations: Injected stalls validate detection, not host-specific acceptance thresholds.

capabilities.risk: Sustained Windows execution may develop unacceptable UI service gaps.
limitations: Evidence is scheduled and host-specific; current stress failures remain findings.

capabilities.risk: Sustained Pi execution may develop unacceptable UI service gaps.
limitations: Pi evidence is machine-specific and traced timings are excluded from comparison.

capabilities.risk: The Windows stress workflow may exhibit unbounded resource growth.
limitations: Resource classification requires scheduled same-host evidence.

capabilities.risk: The Pi stress workflow may exhibit unbounded resource growth.
limitations: Resource classification requires scheduled evidence from the designated Pi.

capabilities.risk: In-process SIL could be mistaken for serial framing and acknowledgement coverage.
limitations: A virtual MCU or prepared HIL fixture is required.

capabilities.risk: A controller or MCU reset may leave execution state ambiguous.
limitations: Reset semantics require protocol simulation or prepared HIL.

capabilities.risk: Software evidence could be misrepresented as physical print-quality evidence.
limitations: Only prepared hardware validation can cover motion, pressure, and droplets.
